messages:
Lena: Quick design check  proposing a compact left rail that groups by task (Build | Serve | Observe) with inline jump-links. Mock attached. Main asks: permalink stability, breadcrumb text, and screen-reader behaviour. Thoughts?

Omar: Love the compactness. Big constraint: external docs and integrations link to resource paths (`/console/models/:id`). We should not change canonical paths. Suggest: UI cluster state -> `?rail=serve`, and allow `#focus=inputs` for deep anchors.

Priya: Accessibility nits: when rail groups expand/collapse we need `aria-expanded` on the toggle and `aria-controls` pointing to the panel. Active item should have `aria-current=\"true\"`. When switching clusters announce e.g. "Rail: Serve" via a polite live region and move focus into the cluster.

Grant: Breadcrumb copy: current is "Models / 1234"  propose "Models \u203a ImageGen v1.2 (1234)" so people get model+version at a glance. Truncation: clamp at 36 chars with middle ellipsis, reveal full string on hover / long-press. Mobile: show compact title like "ImageGen v1.2".

A11yBot: /scan left-rail -> Findings: missing `aria-expanded` on 2 toggles; no live region found for rail-change announcements. Recommend adding `role=\"region\"` + `aria-live=\"polite\"` for active cluster area.

Omar: For anchor handling use `history.replaceState` so back-button isn't polluted. Example shim:

```
// on load
const { hash } = window.location;
if (hash.startsWith('#focus=')) {
  const focus = decodeURIComponent(hash.split('=')[1]);
  router.replace({ pathname: location.pathname, query: { ...router.query, focus } }, undefined, { shallow: true });
  focusPanel(focus); // moves focus + announces
}
```

Test: legacy `/console/models/1234/overview` should redirect to `/console/models/1234?rail=serve&focus=overview` and preserve utm params.

Priya: When focusing a panel call `announceForAccessibility(panelLabel)` and ensure panels have `aria-labelledby`. Clear the live region after announcement to avoid repeats. Add unit tests that assert `aria-current` and screen-reader text updates.

Grant: Analytics: in event payloads emit a normalized path like `/console/models/:id/rail/serve` so dashboards don't fragment on query variants. Also add tests that UTM params survive redirects.

Lena: Action items: 1) routing shim + redirect plan + analytics mapping (Omar), 2) ARIA attributes, polite live region, and axe run (Priya), 3) breadcrumb copy rules + truncation examples and mobile variants (Grant). Sync Fri 10:30.

Omar: I'll open an RFC PR with the shim and migration notes, include server-side fallback examples and redirect rules. ETA Wed EOD.

Priya: I'll add the aria attrs, run `axe-core` and post results here. Will include a tiny Playwright E2E for keyboard focus.

Grant: I'll draft breadcrumb copy doc and attach updated mocks. Will include tooltip copy and truncation edge cases.

A11yBot: Reminder created for Fri 10:30 sync. Calendar invite sent.

Lena: Thanks team  small iterative rollout sounds right. Loom w/ mock: https://loom.com/share/nav-compact-01 (90s). :thumbsup:
